description: This is a shell script that automates the application of database migrations and seed data for a PostgreSQL database. It manages versioned SQL migration files by applying only those that haven't been applied yet, recording applied migrations in a schema_migrations table, and also applies seed SQL files. The script reads database connection info from an external text file, performs necessary checks, and executes SQL commands accordingly.

methods.name: apply_sql_file_once
methods.description: Defines a function to apply a SQL migration file if it has not been applied yet, checking the schema_migrations table and inserting a record after successful application.
